text:
[issue by SMGPDBGMCB]
### Describe the bug

When launching AE2 version 19.2.17 on neoforge 21.1.250 1.21.1:
the game gets stuck not rendering anything while the ui can still be interacted with and sounds can be heard. this  tends to be stuck on the mojang loadingscreen unless i move the window in which case it becomes a black screen.


### How to reproduce the bug

use neoforge 21.1.250, minecraft 1.21.1
get ae2 19.2.17 and guideme 21.1.18
launch the game

### Expected behavior

the title screen should appear

### Additional details

When [Remove Reloading Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/ZP7xHXtw) is added, the title screen can be reached. I found there were some further issues in my kitchen sink modpack when doing that however.

### Which minecraft version are you using?

1.21

### On which mod loaders does it happen?

NeoForge

### Crash log

https://gist.github.com/SMGPDBGMCB/3e7c7a892de5dedee00b1cd82f3affdd

[comment by Mari023 (collaborator)]
this is probably caused by AppliedEnergistics/GuideME#114

downgrading guideme to 21.1.17 should fix it

[comment by SMGPDBGMCB (none)]
yep, it fixes it
thx
